apply_context_parallel: apply context parallel hooks to a PyTorch module using a parallel config and model plan
remove_context_parallel: remove context parallel hooks from a PyTorch module by module id and model plan
shard_tensor_equipartition: shard a tensor across a distributed device mesh using equipartition along a specified dimension
shard_tensor_anything: shard a tensor across a distributed device mesh using flexible partitioning that handles uneven sizes
find_submodule_by_name: find a submodule or list of submodules in a PyTorch model by dot-separated name with optional wildcard
